title: Incorporation of Trinuclear Lanthanide(III) Hydroxo Bridged Clusters in Macrocyclic Frameworks

synthesis.procedure: KOH (24.7 mg, 0.441 mmol) in 3 mL methanol was added dropwise to H3L1^S (78.5 mg, 0.088 mmol) and YCl3·6H2O (133.8 mg, 0.441 mmol) in 10 mL methanol. The mixture was stirred for 40 h at room temperature and left to evaporate. After the volume had decreased by half, colorless crystals formed. A crystal was taken for X-ray analysis; the remainder was filtered, washed with a small amount of cold methanol, and dried in air.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: methanol solution, stirring then slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Slow evaporation to about half volume gave colorless crystals; filtered, washed with cold methanol, and dried in air. Crystals of 1 also grown by slow evaporation of the mother liquor.

synthesis.procedure: NaOH (13.4 mg, 0.335 mmol) in 2 mL methanol was added dropwise to a stirred solution of H3L1^R (82.5 mg, 0.112 mmol; the printed ligand label L2 is inconsistent with the stated molar mass, ESI, and C45 formula) and Sm(NO3)3·6H2O (148.9 mg, 0.335 mmol) in 5 mL methanol. The mixture was stirred for 20 h at room temperature. The precipitate was filtered, washed with a small amount of methanol, and dried under vacuum.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Precipitate filtered, washed with a small amount of methanol, and dried under vacuum.

synthesis.procedure: H3L1^S (6.1 mg, 0.0068 mmol) and Sm(NO3)3·6H2O (9.1 mg) were dissolved in 1 mL deuterated methanol in an NMR tube, and KOH in deuterated methanol was added in portions to a final L1^S:KOH molar ratio of 1:5. After 48 h, crystals formed in the NMR tube and were taken directly for X-ray analysis. Remaining crystals were filtered, washed with a small amount of cold methanol, and dried in air.

properties.summary: χMT at room temperature is 32.6 cm^3 K mol^-1, below the 35.4 cm^3 K mol^-1 expected for three noninteracting 7F6 Tb(III) ions (g = 3/2, J = 6). χMT rises to 34.0 cm^3 K mol^-1 near 100 K and falls to 14.1 cm^3 K mol^-1 at 1.8 K. The initial increase may indicate weak ferromagnetic exchange together with thermal depopulation of mJ sublevels and anisotropy.

synthesis.procedure: Sm(NO3)3·6H2O (533.4 mg, 1.2 mmol) was added to L2^S (346.1 mg, 0.4 mmol) in 10 mL methanol and stirred until dissolved. Triethylamine (0.28 mL, 2 mmol) was added, the solution was stirred for 1 h, and left at room temperature without stirring to evaporate. After four days white crystals suitable for X-ray analysis formed, were separated by decantation, washed with a small amount of methanol, and dried.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: White crystals after four days; decanted, washed with methanol, and dried. Crystal cation [Sm3L2^S(NO3)3(OH)2(H2O)3]+ (Figure 9).

properties.summary: Weak antiferromagnetic coupling between three Gd(III) ions. χMT is 23.4 cm^3 K mol^-1 at 300 K (expected 23.6) and falls to 8.28 cm^3 K mol^-1 at 1.8 K. An isotropic triangle fit gives g = 2.00 and J = -0.17 cm^-1 (R = 0.014); the Weiss constant is negative but not quantified. Enantiomers 10 and 11 show intense UV CD from the ligand chromophores (Figure 5).

properties.summary: Room-temperature χMT is 40.1 cm^3 K mol^-1, slightly below 42.5 cm^3 K mol^-1 for three noninteracting 6H15/2 Dy(III) ions (g = 4/3). χMT rises to 41.4 cm^3 K mol^-1 at 9 K, then falls to 25.0 cm^3 K mol^-1 at 1.8 K. The rise may reflect ferromagnetic interactions; the drop is attributed mainly to mJ depopulation and anisotropy, possibly with weak antiferromagnetic coupling. Susceptibility does not vanish at 1.8 K. Two independent molecules with different axial ligands lower the symmetry of the exchange paths.

synthesis.procedure: KOH (35.0 mg, 0.625 mmol) in 5 mL methanol was added dropwise to H3L1^S (112.0 mg, 0.125 mmol) and La(NO3)3·6H2O (270.6 mg, 0.625 mmol) in 15 mL methanol. The mixture was stirred for 40 h at room temperature and left to evaporate. After the volume decreased by half, colorless crystals formed. One crystal was removed for X-ray work; the rest was filtered, washed with a small amount of cold methanol, and dried in air. NMR and a preliminary structure indicate two macrocycles sharing one La(III), not the symmetric Ln3(μ3-OH)2 cluster.
